title: R30: box stops talking over the bed
question: Corner: does it now read as ticks-only (plus MIN HZ, the one sole-route exception)? Hover: does the cell readout correctly follow the LOOK tool?
context_md: Two of the owner's asks, both view-only: (1) the cell readout (material/moisture/organism) should only show while LOOK is armed; (2) the top-left corner should carry ticks and nothing else. Same bed and cursor cell (300,150) in the paired hover shots; same capture frame for the corner pair. `MIN 10HZ` is kept beside ticks -- it is the only on-screen readout of the display-floor value `F` cycles, so cutting it would strand that control (flagged to the coordinator for lane R2's master menu to re-home later).
